QUOTE: **Only `SearchScreen` shows a search field.** `NavigationHeader` defaults `hasSearch` to `false`, and only the `hasSearch && <NavigationSearch …/>` branch in `app/components/navigation_header/index.tsx` renders an input.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that `SearchScreen` in `app/screens/home/search/search.tsx` is the only caller that passes `hasSearch={true}`, which enables the search field.
